Application Data.NAME: ABC Floor Covering Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Floor Covering Solutions specializes in the retail sale, installation, and maintenance of various floor coverings, including carpets, hardwood, vinyl, and tile. Our operations are primarily conducted from a fixed showroom location in Springfield, IL, where clients can view our products and receive expert consultations. We employ trained professionals for all installation services to ensure quality workmanship and compliance with safety standards. Additionally, we provide on-site installation services at residential and commercial properties, offering tailored solutions to meet our clients' specific flooring needs. Our commitment to customer satisfaction and adherence to industry best practices minimizes risks associated with improper installation and ensures minimal disruption during our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 15, 2023, a water damage incident occurred at a client's residence during the installation of a vinyl floor, caused by an unintentional puncture in the existing plumbing. The damage resulted in a claim amount of $5,000. The claim has been settled and the status is closed as of August 30, 2023.

Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during business hours and alarm system monitoring.
